player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I stopped the exploration prematurely after visiting only four rooms, leaving unvisited rooms (like the one accessible from the Exercise room via east) undiscovered. Additionally, my graph construction was incomplete; I failed to record the edges I traversed (e.g., the connection between Media room and Playroom, or Garage and Exercise room) in the `edges` dictionary, only updating the `nodes` list. Next time, I will maintain a persistent mental map of all visited nodes and edges, ensuring every transition is added to the `edges` object before moving. I will only output "DONE" when I have explicitly confirmed that all currently available directions from every visited node have been explored and no new rooms remain reachable.
